Theme

Latin word

nūllus

nūllus, nūlla, nūllum

adjective; gen. nūllīus, dat. nūllī

no, not any; no (person); nobody, in the cases nēmō lacks; none, not one; none, no

In this lexicon

  • no

    the recommended word · classical · Gell. 17.8.5: nūllum inde ībat oleum; Plin. NH 9.42: nūllum animal graviōre somnō premitur; Traupman 351

  • nobody

    also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 3.4: et omnibus crēdere et nūllī

  • none

    the recommended word · classical · Hor. Ep. 1.1.75: nūlla retrōrsum; Cic. Off. 3.59: nūllae, quod sciam

  • zero

    also used · classical

  • Aut Caesar aut nūllus.: all or nothing

    Renaissance
